company.name: AllSome
company.shortDescription: AllSome is a parcel tracking system that provides e-commerce fulfillment and logistic solutions for online sellers.
company.description:
AllSome is a platform that connect modern online merchants to spare warehouse to store and send cross-border shipment in a painless way, specifically focused from China to South East Asia. AllSome provides services to procure, receive, quality check, store, and send packages directly to buyers'​ doorstep at an affordable and painless way.

The company was founded on 2017 and is based in ShenZhen, China.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,940,000, or 92.82% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,276,039 to $15,814,013, a 1.91x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 60 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 60 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
